en: Philippine Independence Day on June 12 is exactly 22 days before the American Independence Day on July 4.
The Philippine Senate has exactly 24 members, while the House of Representatives has over 300 district and party-list members.
Jose Rizal was 35 years old when he died, making him exactly 6 years older than Andres Bonifacio, who died at 29.
The Philippines has over 180 distinct languages, whereas Japan primarily uses only one national language, Japanese.
The national animal, the carabao, can weigh up to 1,500 kilograms, which is 300 times heavier than the 5-kilogram Philippine Eagle.
Filipino scientist Gregorio Zara invented the two-way videophone in 1955, which was 15 years before the first commercial video call in 1970.
The Dinagyang Festival in Iloilo is held on the fourth Sunday of January, exactly one week after the Ati-Atihan Festival.
The Mangyan people of Mindoro have 8 distinct ethnolinguistic groups, which is exactly 2 more than the 6 major groups of the Cordillera Igorots.
The mandatory retirement age for Philippine government employees is 65, which is exactly 47 years after the minimum voting age of 18.
Juan Luna’s painting Spoliarium is 4.22 meters tall, which is more than twice the height of a standard 2-meter classroom door.
Article III of the 1987 Constitution has 22 sections for the Bill of Rights, which is 6 more sections than the 16 in the 1935 version.
The Katipunan secret society grew from just 5 founding members in 1892 to over 30,000 members by the 1896 Philippine Revolution.
